T01.cypher: MATCH (c:Consumer) RETURN c.category AS category, count(*) AS n ORDER BY n DESC

T02.cypher: MATCH (s:Substation)-[:LOCATED_IN]->(:Region {name: 'Рівненська область'}) RETURN s.id AS substation, round(100.0 * s.currentLoad / s.nominalCapacity, 1) AS loadPct

T03.cypher: MATCH (c:Consumer)-[:HAS_METER]->(m:Meter {status: 'несправний'}) MATCH (c)-[:CONNECTED_TO]->(s:Substation) RETURN m.id AS meter, s.id AS substation

T04.cypher: MATCH (fm:ForecastModel)-[:GENERATED]->(f:Forecast) RETURN fm.id AS model, count(f) AS n ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 1

T05.cypher: MATCH (:Dispatcher {id: 'Dispatcher_5'})-[:USES_FORECAST]->(f:Forecast)-[:FORECAST_FOR]->(s:Substation) RETURN f.id AS forecast, s.id AS substation

T06.cypher: MATCH (:Substation {id: 'Substation_1'})-[:FEEDS*1..10]->(s:Substation) RETURN DISTINCT s.id AS substation

T07.cypher: MATCH (fm:ForecastModel)-[:GENERATED]->(f:Forecast) RETURN fm.modelType AS modelType, avg(f.errorPercentage) AS avgError

T08.cypher: MATCH (c:Consumer)-[:CONNECTED_TO]->(s:Substation) WHERE s.currentLoad >= 0.85 * s.nominalCapacity RETURN c.id AS consumer, s.id AS substation

T09.cypher: MATCH (c:Consumer {id: 'Consumer_1002'}), (d:Dispatcher {id: 'Dispatcher_4'}) MATCH p = shortestPath((c)-[*..15]-(d)) RETURN length(p) AS hops

T10.cypher: MATCH (w:WeatherCondition)-[:AFFECTS_MODEL]->(fm:ForecastModel) WHERE w.temperature < -10 RETURN DISTINCT fm.id AS model

T11.cypher: MATCH (s:Substation) WHERE NOT EXISTS { MATCH (:Forecast)-[:FORECAST_FOR]->(s) } RETURN s.id AS substation

T12.cypher: MATCH (c:Consumer)-[:HAS_METER]->(m:Meter), (c)-[:CONNECTED_TO]->(:Substation)-[:LOCATED_IN]->(r:Region) RETURN r.name AS region, round(1.0 * sum(CASE WHEN m.status = 'несправний' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / count(m), 3) AS share

T13.cypher: MATCH (x:Measurement) WHERE x.timestamp >= localdatetime('2026-09-28T00:00:00') AND x.timestamp < localdatetime('2026-09-29T00:00:00') RETURN x.id AS measurement

T14.cypher: MATCH (d:Dispatcher)-[:MANAGES]->(:Substation)-[:FEEDS*0..10]->(s:Substation)<-[:CONNECTED_TO]-(c:Consumer) WITH DISTINCT d, c RETURN d.id AS dispatcher, sum(c.contractLimit) AS totalLimit

T15.cypher: MATCH (d:Dispatcher)-[:MANAGES]->(:Substation)<-[:CONNECTED_TO]-(c:Consumer) RETURN d.id AS dispatcher, count(DISTINCT c) AS consumers ORDER BY consumers DESC LIMIT 1
